    *   B. "Rejective Ho, p > 0.05": If the p-value is greater than the significance level, we usually fail to reject $H_0$. Rejecting $H_0$ is incorrect here.
    *   C. "Rejective H1, p < 0.05": $H_1$ is the alternative hypothesis. We generally do not "reject" the alternative hypothesis directly; we reject the null hypothesis in favor of the alternative. If p < 0.05, we reject $H_0$ (and accept $H_1$), not "reject $H_1$".
    *   D. "Accepting Ho, p < 0.05": We never statistically "accept" the null hypothesis definitively; we fail to reject it. If p < 0.05, we definitely do *not* accept $H_0$.
